problem.name: CRITICAL_SIBLING_SIGNED_LITERAL_SUBSTITUTION_TRANSPORT_DISCOVERY
problem.input: A width-3 CNF parent P with distinguished pivot z, promised maximum-deficiency-critical, together with the two simplified siblings A=P[z=0] and B=P[z=1].
problem.question: Does there exist a many-to-one signed literal substitution phi from variables of target A to signed literals over variables of source B such that every target clause image is tautological or contains a source clause?
problem.verification: A supplied phi and clause witnesses are polynomially checkable.

construction: Given G=(V,E), add one universal vertex u adjacent to every original vertex. Call the result Gplus. Then Gplus is 4-colorable iff G is 3-colorable.
For every vertex v of Gplus add three private vertices a_v,b_v,c_v and all six edges of the K4 on {v,a_v,b_v,c_v}. Retain every edge of Gplus. Call the resulting graph H_G.
Let target A_G be the monotone 2CNF having one clause (x_p OR x_q) for every edge {p,q} of H_G.
Let source B_K4 be the fixed monotone 2CNF containing all six edge clauses of K4 on y1,y2,y3,y4.
Introduce fresh pivot z and set P_G={z OR C:C in A_G} union {NOT z OR D:D in B_K4}.

substitution_correctness.allowed_signed_graph: On signed source literals {+yi,-yi}, a target edge image is valid exactly when it is a positive K4 edge or a tautological opposite-sign pair {+yi,-yi}. Thus the allowed graph is positive K4 plus four negative leaves -yi attached only to +yi.
substitution_correctness.private_K4_force: The only 4-clique of the allowed signed graph is the positive K4. Hence every private target K4 maps bijectively to +y1,+y2,+y3,+y4 and in particular every original Gplus vertex receives a positive color.
substitution_correctness.original_edges: Every Gplus edge forces distinct positive colors.
substitution_correctness.equivalence: A substitution A_G -> B_K4 exists iff Gplus is 4-colorable iff G is 3-colorable.

criticality.graph_excess_definition: For a monotone graph-CNF clause subset S, deficiency equals graph excess ex(S)=|E(S)|-|V(S)|.
criticality.target_full_excess: If N=|V(Gplus)| and M=|E(Gplus)|, then H_G has 4N vertices and M+6N edges, so ex(H_G)=M+2N.
target_unique_maximum: For any selected edge subset S of H_G, let E0 be selected Gplus edges; let O be original Gplus vertices incident to S; for each v let T_v be selected edges of the private K4 at v and P_v the selected private vertices incident to T_v.
If v is not in O, T_v uses only private vertices and |T_v|-|P_v|<=0. If v is in O, |T_v|-|P_v|<=3, with equality 3 only when all six private-K4 edges are selected.
Therefore ex(S)<=|E0|+2|O|<=M+2N. Equality forces E0=E(Gplus), O=V(Gplus), and every private K4 complete, hence S=E(H_G). Thus every proper target clause subset has excess <=M+2N-1.
criticality.source_unique_maximum: For K4, full excess is 6-4=2. Every proper edge subset has excess <=1; the empty subset has excess 0.
criticality.parent_rank: For any nonempty parent clause subset Q=Q_A union Q_B, delta(Q)=ex(Q_A)+ex(Q_B)-1 because the two variable sets are disjoint except for the common pivot z. Hence the full parent has delta*=M+2N+1 and is the unique maximum-deficiency subset.
criticality.siblings: P_G[z=0]=A_G with delta*=M+2N; P_G[z=1]=B_K4 with delta*=2. Both are strict rank descendants of the maxdef-critical parent.

theorem.membership_in_NP: The substitution certificate has polynomial size and is checked clause-by-clause in polynomial time.
theorem.conclusion: The discovery problem remains NP-complete even under the promise that the two siblings come from a maximum-deficiency-critical width-3 parent.

effect_on_TRUMP.meaning: Many-to-one substitution remains a valid exact safe-deletion relation, but universal polynomial discovery of that relation cannot be the missing L3 mechanism merely by restricting inputs to maxdef-critical siblings.
effect_on_TRUMP.next_frontier: Either find a strictly different polynomially discoverable safe-deletion relation, or prove additional structural restrictions beyond maxdef-criticality that make substitution discovery tractable and cover every remaining critical state.
